segments.an10.67:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena naḷakapānaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ nigamo tadavasari.
segments.an10.67:1.2: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā naḷakapāne viharati palāsavane.
segments.an10.67:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadahuposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
segments.an10.67:1.4: Atha kho bhagavā bahudeva rattiṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.an10.67:2.1: “Vigatathinamiddho [vigatathīnamiddho (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] kho, sāriputta, bhikkhusaṅgho.
segments.an10.67:2.2: Paṭibhātu taṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammī kathā.
segments.an10.67:2.5: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.an10.67:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā.
segments.an10.67:3.2: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an10.67:3.4: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.an10.67:4.1: “Yassa kassaci, āvuso, saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hirī [hiri (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] natthi … ottappaṃ natthi … vīriyaṃ [viriyaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] natthi … paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.
segments.an10.67:4.5: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, kāḷapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāyateva vaṇṇena hāyati maṇḍalena hāyati ābhāya hāyati ārohapariṇāhena;
segments.an10.67:4.6: evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hirī natthi … ottappaṃ natthi … vīriyaṃ natthi … paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.
segments.an10.67:6.1: “Yassa kassaci, āvuso, saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, hirī atthi … ottappaṃ atthi … paññā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni.
segments.an10.67:6.4: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, juṇhapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vaḍḍhateva vaṇṇena vaḍḍhati maṇḍalena vaḍḍhati ābhāya vaḍḍhati ārohapariṇāhena;
segments.an10.67:6.5: evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, yassa kassaci saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, hirī atthi … ottappaṃ atthi … vīriyaṃ atthi … paññā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni.
segments.an10.67:8.1: Atha kho bhagavā paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.an10.67:8.3: Yassa kassaci, sāriputta, saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hirī natthi … ottappaṃ natthi … vīriyaṃ natthi … paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.
segments.an10.67:8.7: Seyyathāpi, sāriputta, kāḷapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, hāyateva vaṇṇena hāyati maṇḍalena hāyati ābhāya hāyati ārohapariṇāhena;
segments.an10.67:8.8: evamevaṃ kho, sāriputta, yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu … pe … paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā … pe … no vuddhi.
segments.an10.67:9.2: ahiriko … anottappī … kusīto … duppañño … kodhano … upanāhī … pāpiccho … pāpamitto …‘micchādiṭṭhiko purisapuggalo’ti, sāriputta, parihānametaṃ.
segments.an10.67:10.1: “Yassa kassaci, sāriputta, saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, hirī atthi … ottappaṃ atthi … vīriyaṃ atthi … paññā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni.
segments.an10.67:10.5: Seyyathāpi, sāriputta, juṇhapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vaḍḍhateva vaṇṇena vaḍḍhati maṇḍalena vaḍḍhati ābhāya vaḍḍhati ārohapariṇāhena;
segments.an10.67:10.6: evamevaṃ kho, sāriputta, yassa kassaci saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, hirī atthi … ottappaṃ atthi … vīriyaṃ atthi … paññā atthi kusalesu dhammesu, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni.
segments.an10.67:11.2: hirīmā … ottappī … āraddhavīriyo … paññavā … akkodhano … anupanāhī … appiccho … kalyāṇamitto …‘sammādiṭṭhiko purisapuggalo’ti, sāriputta, aparihānametan”ti.
